up: Retrieve all distinct molecules that appear in the document with ChEMBL ID CHEMBL1142710. The document is identified in the docs table by its chembl_id. Link molecules through the compound_records table (using doc_id to doc_id and molregno to molecule_dictionary.molregno). For each distinct molecule, output its molecule ChEMBL ID (molecule_dictionary.chembl_id), its compound name (compound_records.compound_name), and its canonical SMILES (compound_structures.canonical_smiles). Only include molecules that have a canonical SMILES available (canonical_smiles IS NOT NULL). If a molecule has multiple compound names in the document, pick one arbitrarily to preserve distinctness. Order the results by chembl_id, compound_name, and canonical_smiles in ascending order.
sql:
SELECT
    md.chembl_id,
    MIN(cr.compound_name) AS compound_name,
    cs.canonical_smiles
FROM docs d
JOIN compound_records cr ON d.doc_id = cr.doc_id
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON cr.molregno = md.molregno
JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno
WHERE d.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1142710'
  AND cs.canonical_smiles IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY md.chembl_id, cs.canonical_smiles
ORDER BY md.chembl_id, compound_name, cs.canonical_smiles;
